name: chrome-devtools-mcp
one_liner: Lets an AI coding assistant open a real Chrome browser, click around, and debug your website exactly like a human developer would.
buyer: A solo developer or QA lead who wants automated bug-hunting and performance checks without a dedicated QA engineer.
business_use_cases: A small agency has its AI assistant automatically test and screenshot every client site after each deploy, catching visual bugs.
A freelance developer uses it to have an AI diagnose 'why is this page slow' issues for client sites.
A QA-as-a-service offering runs AI-driven browser regression checks for small business websites.

money_ideas.idea: Offer an 'AI QA checkup' subscription for small business websites: automated visual and performance checks every week.

steal_this: Build a $50/month 'is my website broken' monitoring service for local businesses this weekend, using this as the checking engine.
